Fist Kuthbert is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. He can be found in the streets of Lower City in Act Three.
“
I said move along - unless you have a piglet up there somewhere, this doesn't concern you.
„
— Kuthbert

Involvement

Kuthbert is stationed outside the Basilisk Gate Barracks, just aside the gate proper. He acts as a towncrier, announcing the confiscation of any remaining livestock from the citizen of Baldur's Gate "under the protection of the ducal council". Kuthbert is surrounded by a small group of farmers -  Turnip Bubbs,  Ploughman Zakk,  Drussuvissill and  Asparagus Mhallie, who take their outrage out on him for enforcing  Enver Gortash's decrees. Kuthbert attempts to maintain peace, but is not actually interested in solving the bidders’ problems.

If spoken with, Kuthbert tells the party to move along and leave him to placate the crowd. However, his attitude to the party might differ depending on the positive / negative article printed about them in the Baldur's Mouth Gazette (or neither printed at all), as an outcome for ⁠Stop the Presses quest.

Idle banter

  • Fist Kuthbert
    Any complaints will be handled after you turn your animals over to the care of the ducal council.
  • Turnip Bubbs
    And what good is that going to do us? How are we going to support ourselves?
  • Drussuvissill
    My thoughts exactly - you're sentencing us all to a slow death.
  • Ploughman Zakk
    Please, sir - we have children. We need to be able to provide for them.
  • Fist Kuthbert
    Not my concern.
  • Turnip Bubbs
    Not like we can even turn around and leave now - Absolute's hemmed us in good and proper.
  • Fist Kuthbert
    Please provide a full inventory of any and all livestock before entering Baldur's Gate proper. Smuggling or any other form of deceit will not be tolerated.
  • Drussuvissill
    What are you going to do - check under my skirt for any stray chickens?
  • Fist Kuthbert
    All animals must be surrendered. Failure to do so will-
  • Drussuvissill
    Result in a good hiding from Lord Gortash, got it. Thank you.
  • Turnip Bubbs
    This is out-and-out madness.
  • Ploughman Zakk
    Torm help us, what do we do?
